concept.title: Advice, advocacy and one-to-one support
concept.shortdesc: Getting advice, advocacy, signposting and individual or phone-based support on money, legal, immigration and other everyday problems.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Being pointed or referred to other organisations and services that can provide the right help.
: Getting advice, representation or accompaniment on legal matters and rights, including help at court.
: Receiving independent advocacy to be heard, understand rights and take part in decisions about care and support.
: Getting help, advice, counselling or friendly contact by phone, helpline, text or similar remote contact.
: Getting free, confidential and impartial advice on money, debt, benefits, housing and related problems.
: Getting individual support from a worker or volunteer on a one-to-one basis, in person, by phone or online.
: Advice and casework covering several problems at once, such as benefits, housing and welfare, together with asylum, immigration and migrant support.
: Advice and support about money problems, debt, welfare benefits, cost of living and related financial matters.
